dialogues.jp: ――穏やかな風が吹いている。

時間が遅いためか屋上には人の姿はなく、俺と
音夢のふたりだけしかいない。
dialogues.en:
There was only us on the roof top since it was late in the
afternoon.
dialogues.text:
There was only us on the roof top since it was late in the
afternoon.

dialogues.jp:
屋上から望む景色は爽やか過ぎていて、今の俺
には逆に嫌味にすら感じた。
dialogues.en:
Everything seemed so perfect, from this point up on the
roof, that it felt too much to me.
dialogues.text:
Everything seemed so perfect, from this point up on the
roof, that it felt too much to me.

dialogues.jp:
このまま時間が止まってしまえばいいと――か
なり本気で願ったりしているのだが。
dialogues.en:
And I found myself wishing I could stop time and stay in
this moment forever......
dialogues.text:
And I found myself wishing I could stop time and stay in
this moment forever......

dialogues.jp: 「ううう……」
あ、涙がこぼれそう……だって男の子だもん。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、空ばっか見上げてなくていいから。
　本当に美味しいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, don't look at the sky like that. The food's really
good."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, don't look at the sky like that. The food's really
good."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いやさ……見た目だけはいつも美味しそうな
　んだけどな」

現実に立ち返って、チラシを座布団代わりにし
てあぐらをかく。
dialogues.en: I came back to reality and grabbed a flier to sit on.
dialogues.text: I came back to reality and grabbed a flier to sit on.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ね、兄さん。｛だま／騙｝されたと思って♪」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……その言葉だけは聞きたくなかったぞ」
dialogues.en: "......That was the last thing I wanted to hear."
dialogues.text: "......That was the last thing I wanted to hear."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいから、食べてみて｛まず／不味｝かったら文句を言っ
　てよぉ！」
dialogues.en: "Go for it. You can complain after you try it!"
dialogues.text: "Go for it. You can complain after you try it!"

dialogues.jp: ずい、と弁当を音夢が突き出してくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu pushed the bento box toward me.
dialogues.text: Nemu pushed the bento box toward me.

dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ。｛はし／箸｝くれ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん♪　ちょっと待ってて……」
ごそごそ、と脇の手提げを音夢が漁る。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked into the bag she had by her side.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked into the bag she had by her side.

dialogues.jp: 漁る。
漁る……。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ちょっと待ってて……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まさか忘れたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me you forgot my chopsticks."
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me you forgot my chopsticks."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う、う〜ん……いつも自分のぶんだけだった
　からそのまま」
dialogues.en: "Well...... it's usually just for me so......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... it's usually just for me so......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうかそうか」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんで嬉しそうなのよ〜」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、人間、悲しみも感｛きわ／極｝まると笑みが浮
　かぶものだ」
dialogues.en: "I guess it's like when you smile when you're really sad."
dialogues.text: "I guess it's like when you smile when you're really sad."

dialogues.jp:
腕組みしつつ、思わず｛さわ／爽｝やかな笑みを浮かべて
しまう。
dialogues.en: I folded my arms and smiled.
dialogues.text: I folded my arms and smiled.

dialogues.jp:
対照的にぶすっ、としていた音夢だが、急に笑
みを浮かべて――。
dialogues.en:
Nemu looked unhappy in contrast, but then she smiled all of
a sudden.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looked unhappy in contrast, but then she smiled all of
a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいもん箸なんて１本あれば十分です……は
　い、あ〜んして」
dialogues.en:
"All we need is just one pair of chopsticks...... here, open
your mouth."
dialogues.text:
"All we need is just one pair of chopsticks...... here, open
your mouth."

dialogues.jp:
卵焼きが挟まれた箸が、俺の口元に伸ばされて
いた。
dialogues.en:
I found a pair of chopsticks with an omelet roll in front of
my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I found a pair of chopsticks with an omelet roll in front of
my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜ん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、美味しいから♪」

ぱく、と卵焼きの半分を毒見だとかじって、残
りをそのまま差し出してくる。
dialogues.en:
She ate half of the omelet to ensure that it was edible, and
she gave me the rest of the half.
dialogues.text:
She ate half of the omelet to ensure that it was edible, and
she gave me the rest of the half.

dialogues.jp: ――すっく。
思いきり立ち上がって走り出す。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、ちょっと兄さん！？」
声を無視して校舎への扉を駆け抜ける。
dialogues.en: I ignored her and ran through the door to the main building.
dialogues.text: I ignored her and ran through the door to the main building.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん、朝倉？　なにやってんの」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ッ！」
見知った声に慌てて足を止める。
dialogues.en: I stopped when I heard the familiar voice.
dialogues.text: I stopped when I heard the familiar voice.

dialogues.jp: 「……はぁはぁ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「また、なにか悪さして追いかけられてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Did you do something bad and try to run away?"
dialogues.text: "Did you do something bad and try to run away?"

dialogues.jp: わなわな、と手を持ち上げる。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なによ……なんか事故でもあったの？」
dialogues.en: "What? Did you have an accident or something?"
dialogues.text: "What? Did you have an accident or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なにを、とち狂ったんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんなんだあいつはッ！？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたが、なんなのよ……」
息を落ち着けようと窓の外に目を向けた。
dialogues.en: I looked outside to calm myself down.
dialogues.text: I looked outside to calm myself down.

dialogues.jp: 「陽気のせいか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it because of the nice weather?"
dialogues.text: "Is it because of the nice weather?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ね、あたしもう行っていい？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you mind if I go now?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you mind if I go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんか今朝から頭のネジが飛んでいるような
　気はしていたんだが……」
dialogues.en: "I knew something was off since this morning......"
dialogues.text: "I knew something was off since this morning......"

dialogues.jp: ｛あご／顎｝に手を当てる。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「杉並の話？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず本人に確認してみるか」
dialogues.en: "I think I should ask her myself."
dialogues.text: "I think I should ask her myself."

dialogues.jp: 呟いて、また小走りに屋上へ向かう。
dialogues.en: I mumbled and started to run back to the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I mumbled and started to run back to the rooftop.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……なんなの、いったい！？」

眞子が背中で声を発したが、まったくその通り
だ。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ぽつ〜ん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おっし、ただいま」
屋上の扉をぶち開けて、しゅた、と手をかざす。
dialogues.en:
I opened the door to the rooftop loudly, and raised my hand
to greet her.
dialogues.text:
I opened the door to the rooftop loudly, and raised my hand
to greet her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、兄さん……どうしたのよ急に走り出して。
　トイレ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, niisan...... What happened to leave like that? Did you
have to go to the restroom?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, niisan...... What happened to leave like that? Did you
have to go to the restroom?"

dialogues.jp: ｛りちぎ／律儀｝に弁当をそのままに、音夢が立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: Nemu stood up still holding the bento box.
dialogues.text: Nemu stood up still holding the bento box.

dialogues.jp: 「似たようなものだ」
チラシに腰をおろして頷く。
dialogues.en: I nodded and sat down on the flier.
dialogues.text: I nodded and sat down on the flier.

dialogues.jp: 「で、さっきのはなんの冗談だ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さっきの？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その……あ〜ん、て」
dialogues.en: "You know...... the open your mouth thing..."
dialogues.text: "You know...... the open your mouth thing..."

dialogues.jp:
あまりの台詞のこっぱずかしさに、頬が熱を帯
びるのが分かる。
dialogues.en:
What she said was so embarrassing, I felt my cheeks getting
red when she repeated it.
dialogues.text:
What she said was so embarrassing, I felt my cheeks getting
red when she repeated it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「は、箸がないんだから仕方ないし……ああい
　うのは仕方ないでしょ！」
dialogues.en:
"Well, there's only one pair of chopsticks and there was no
other way!"
dialogues.text:
"Well, there's only one pair of chopsticks and there was no
other way!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「写真撮るときに、つい『チーズ』って言っちゃ
　うのと同じですぅ」
dialogues.en: "It's kind of like saying 'Cheese' when you take a picture."
dialogues.text: "It's kind of like saying 'Cheese' when you take a picture."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そうなんだけどさ……」

｛さすが／流石｝に手づかみで食えとは言わないだろうが、
あんまりにもいきなりだし。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure she wouldn't tell me to eat with my hands, but I
didn't see that coming.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure she wouldn't tell me to eat with my hands, but I
didn't see that coming.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それに……」
なぜか胸がドキドキする。
dialogues.en: I don't know why, but my heart's pounding.
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but my heart's pounding.

dialogues.jp:
可笑しなことに、音夢のうつむいたり、上目遣
いで俺の様子をうかがったり――。
dialogues.en:
It's so weird, but the way she looks down, or looks up at
me---
dialogues.text:
It's so weird, but the way she looks down, or looks up at
me---

dialogues.jp: そんな、ちょっとした仕草が可愛く見える。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「デ、デートだって言ったでしょ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……じ、自分で言ってて恥ずかしがるなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't get embarrassed by saying it yourself."
dialogues.text: "Don't get embarrassed by saying it yourself."

dialogues.jp:
お互いに口が上手く回らなくて、しどろもどろ
な会話にしかならない。
dialogues.en:
We couldn't talk well, and we were stumbling to talk to each
other.
dialogues.text:
We couldn't talk well, and we were stumbling to talk to each
other.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「こほん……とりあえず、こうしないとご飯が
　食べられないんだからお覚悟を」
dialogues.en:
"Anyways...... you should make up your mind, because this is
the only way you can eat lunch."
dialogues.text:
"Anyways...... you should make up your mind, because this is
the only way you can eat lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんの覚悟だ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら……あ、あ〜ん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だから恥ずかしいならやるなっての！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないでしょうが！」

ギャアギャアわめきながら、そう言えば箸だけ
借りて自分で食べればいいと思ったのは１０分
後のことだった。
dialogues.en:
Afterwards, I realized what I should have done was to borrow
her chopsticks and eat it myself. But it was 10 minutes
later.
dialogues.text:
Afterwards, I realized what I should have done was to borrow
her chopsticks and eat it myself. But it was 10 minutes
later.

dialogues.jp: ◆箸一膳◆

弁当だけ持ってきて箸を一膳しか持ってこなかっ
た音夢。これで助かるかと思いきや、“あ〜ん”
と言いだして……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu brought lunch boxes but she only brought one pair of
chopsticks. I thought I didn't have to eat her lunch but she
told me to open my mouth......
dialogues.text:
Nemu brought lunch boxes but she only brought one pair of
chopsticks. I thought I didn't have to eat her lunch but she
told me to open my mouth......

dialogues.jp:
お互いにギャアギャアわめきながら、そう言え
ば箸だけ借りて自分で食べればいいと思ったの
は、１０分後のことだった。
dialogues.en:
We were feeling awkward about it, but then I realized ten
minutes later that I should have borrowed her chopsticks and
eaten it myself.
dialogues.text:
We were feeling awkward about it, but then I realized ten
minutes later that I should have borrowed her chopsticks and
eaten it myself.
